references.access_scope: Publisher abstract as indexed; Crossref metadata
references.supported_claim: An adult fly wiring reconstruction supplies structural context. It does not by itself validate this rate model or its memory tasks.

references.access_scope: Publisher full-text abstract/data context; Crossref metadata
references.supported_claim: Hierarchical neuron/cell-type annotation provides context for role-based selection. Role labels do not establish physiological calibration.

references.locator: Abstract; Main sensorimotor validation; Methods/model description
references.supported_claim: The authors test a leaky integrate-and-fire connectivity model on feeding/grooming predictions with experimental validation. DrosoMem uses different rate dynamics and symbolic tasks.
A liquid-state computational framework uses transient circuit states and learned readouts for temporal tasks. Its theoretical statements are not directly transferred to this model.

references.access_scope: Author institution listing and original PDF metadata; PDF text extraction incomplete
references.supported_claim: The original report studies short-term memory in echo-state networks. Detailed metric distinctions in this draft rely on the accessible Dambre primary definition.

references.access_scope: Author-institution published PDF and bibliographic record; Crossref metadata
references.supported_claim: The paper defines reconstruction-based capacity and bounds sums over orthogonal target functions under stated assumptions. Categorical lag accuracy is a different operational quantity.

references.locator: Building a reservoir computer; Tutorial cross-species comparison; Data availability
references.supported_claim: conn2res studies connectome architectures with readout training. Its fruit-fly example uses FlyCircuit and lacks the reported null advantage seen for other species; this is not a replication of our assay.

references.access_scope: Publisher indexed abstract/conclusions, authors ESA project page; Crossref metadata
references.supported_claim: The authors report reduced overfitting in connectome-derived chaotic time-series reservoirs and compare topology/weight hybrids. Task, normalization, selection and readout conditions differ from DrosoMem.

references.status: preprint; submitted to Neural Networks, not treated as peer-reviewed
references.locator: Abstract; normalization discussion; appendix architecture descriptions
references.supported_claim: The C. elegans preprint discusses coupled architecture and global rescaling effects under spectral-radius normalization. It motivates normalization accounting, not a direct comparison with our incoming-L1 results.
